caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall, vase-like glass object that is predominantly rendered in shades of purple. The object sits upright and has a broad, circular base that tapers inward before widening again towards the middle, and then tapers once more before flaring outward sharply at the top to form a wide, open mouth. The form is symmetrical along its vertical axis. The coloring consists of various gradients and highlights in light and dark purple to indicate transparency and reflections on the glass surface. There are subtle brownish-grey shadows cast on the background near the base of the object, and the background itself is off-white with minimal texture or details. In the lower right corner, the name "LILLIAN CAUSEY" is written in small, grey text.
title: Vase
